entries.h: A Danite, son of Manoah; miraculous birth of; a Nazarite from his mother’ s womb; the mother forbidden to drink wine or
Desires a Philistine woman for his wife; kills a lion
His marriage feast and the riddle propounded
Is avenged for the estrangement of his wife
Kills one-thousand Philistines with the jawbone of a donkey
Cohabits with Delilah, a prostitute; her machinations with the Philistines to over- come him
Is blinded by the Philistines and confined to hard labor in prison; pulls down the pillars of the temple, meets his deat
